dev.tanrei.vocabulary.rationale: One product lets people pick one or several of a few related options (a range, a view, days of the week) from a joined row of segments, at the heights of its buttons, some segments with icons or icon-only, some disabled.

dev.tanrei.llm.usage: Everything a segmented button reads: the set (fill, outline, outer corners, inner padding), the dividers between segments, per size a segment's height, paddings, gap, label style, icon and check sizes, the corners where segments meet, the motion, and for each condition (unselected, selected) the colors and elevation of a segment in each state.
rules: Use a segmented button to choose among two to five options of one setting; use a button group for actions and tabs for views.
Selected must differ from unselected by more than color: the default shows a check; a system that sets check.size to 0 must raise or fill the selected segment so that it stands apart.
The set's outline and dividers keep their colors in every state, so a disabled segment keeps a visible boundary.
Restyle through these tokens in a layer; never fork the component.
Each condition's state-layer.color is the color hover, focus and press mix into a segment; it aliases that condition's label color.
Heights are minimums: a height must hold 2 × padding-block + one label line, and the build reports it when it does not.

dev.tanrei.derive.fixed: The default set has no fill of its own; the surface behind it shows through. A system with a track (a filled set with the selection floating in it) values it.

shape.$description: The set's outer corners, and so the first and last segments' outer corners.

padding.$description: The inset of the segments from the set's edge: 0 joins them to the outline; a system whose selection floats inside a track insets them.

color.$description: The border around the set: a functional 3:1 boundary, as an outlined button's.
The line between two segments, the same as the outline by default so the set reads as one outlined shape cut into segments.

shape.$description: The corners where a segment meets its neighbours (the outer corners of the end segments follow set.shape).

height.$description: Minimum height of the set and of every segment, per size.

padding-inline.$description: Space between a segment's content and its sides, per size.

padding-block.$description: Vertical padding, per size. Heights are minimums, so this shows only when a label wraps or text is enlarged.

gap.$description: Space between the leading glyph and the label, per size.

typescale.$description: The label's text style, per size.

size.$description: The check's box, per size. 0 draws no check and reserves no room for it (a system whose selected segment is told apart by its fill and elevation).

weight.$description: The weight the check of a selected segment is drawn at (the `wght` axis of the icon font): the system's weight for a control's own mark, as the checkbox draws its own, because the check is a thin stroke drawn on the segment's selected fill and is what tells selected from unselected beside the fill's color. The check's box (check.size) does not change with it; only the stroke does. A segment's icon keeps sys.icon.weight.

dev.tanrei.vocabulary.rationale: One product needs the check of a selected segment seen at a glance at the weight its checkboxes draw theirs, since at its small size a light stroke reads fainter than its color; a product with a dense toolbar draws it lighter without touching its icons.

dev.tanrei.derive.fixed: An unselected segment has no fill; the set shows through.

color.$description: The icon, and the check of a selected segment.
The color hover, focus and press mix into the segment: its label color.

state-duration.$description: How long a change of state takes. It follows the size (small over the compact role, medium over the default role, large over the large role): a smaller control changes state sooner.

feedback-duration.$description: How long the ripple takes to spread.

selection-duration.$description: The check appearing or leaving and the segment changing to or from the selected colors.
